lesson: Fleet builder agents (frontend-developer maxTurns 30, ui/compliance/seo 20) ran out of turns on multi-part units (6-7 subtasks, 30-80 tool calls) and returned no StructuredOutput; work was left half-applied on disk. Use general-purpose (no turn cap) for builders, keep fleet types for bounded single-purpose tasks and read-only reviewers, and wrap every agent() in .catch so one failure does not drop a whole lane.
evidence: wf_86481497 W2-2/W2-3, wf_433c53e2 B2/C1, Run 1 compliance/seo/data-model

lesson: A comment containing a glob like app/src/**/*.css closes the CSS comment early (*/) and breaks the build; never write */ inside CSS comments.

Agents whose tools lack Write must return long reports in a schema field; when the schema is rejected (missing required field) the report is still recoverable from the StructuredOutput tool_use input in the agent transcript.
